static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to talk to, but has not yet discussed these negative thoughts with them; interpersonal/social functioning not yet described in detail
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy or counseling received in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to truthfully describe feelings; emotions mainly Anxiety and doubt, cooperation acceptable; speech rate and logical coherence Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Recently troubled by negative thoughts and emotions from the Frankfurt trip: the trip itself was great, but always focusing on the crowded flights, expensive food, and lack of WiFi and other inconveniences, letting the negative parts overshadow the overall experience.
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts have affected my enjoyment of past experiences and my mood and daily life; I hope to improve this situation.

core_beliefs: If things are not good enough or not perfect, it equals failure
My worth and sense of security depend on others' evaluations

special_situations.event: When recalling the Frankfurt trip, noticing the crowded flights, expensive food, and lack of WiFi and other inconveniences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If obvious discomfort or inconvenience occurs during the trip, it means the whole trip was bad/not worthwhile
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to explain with rationalization to control emotion, but keeps ruminating on negative experiences and reduces sharing positive fragments with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These inconveniences ruined the whole trip.

special_situations.event: Facing the requirement of saving and budgeting for a class trip to Japan
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot strictly control spending and save enough soon, I cannot reach the goal, which equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Easing Anxiety by buying small items, avoiding budgeting and monitoring spending
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, I cannot save enough.

special_situations.event: Considers asking classmates with travel experience for financial management and travel experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose my financial troubles, others will think I am irresponsible or strange
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids seeking help and social exposure, keeping silent to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am nosy and strange.

special_situations.event: Before preparing to try communicating with classmates, estimates possible consequences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If this attempt cannot bring good results immediately, it proves this path is useless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Protecting oneself from disappointment and frustration through skepticism and procrastination
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This will not change anything and may hit me harder.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted, to comfortably seek support and enjoy positive travel and life experiences
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as irresponsible, fearing failure and loss of control, then Being rejected or belittled
defense_goal: Avoids being evaluated by keeping distance and avoiding help-seeking
Using Intellectualization, doubt and Self-denial to reduce the risk of Being rejected and failure

object_relations.self_representation: A help-seeker who may be blamed and does not do well enough
object_relations.object_representation: Others who will judge, possibly reject or belittle oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests seeking experience or support from classmates
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Imagining classmates as potential critics, worrying that speaking up will get one labeled 'irresponsible' (transference: Projecting Fear of evaluation onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a hesitant, questioning tone, repeatedly raises 'what if...' questions, avoiding committing to concrete action.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to review positive travel experiences and approach emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes emotional expression will bring loss of control or vulnerability; only objective analysis is safe
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using abstract, general language (e.g., 'theoretically speaking'), reducing emotional vocabulary, shifting to analysis of details and processes.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When probed about feelings behind budget difficulties and spending impulses
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning disappointment at external inconvenience or pressure into self-blame, to avoid directing dissatisfaction at others
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing in a self-blaming tone 'it is all because I am not good enough / I cannot do it', avoiding expressing the impact of the environment or others.

manifestations: Unwilling to discuss Financial worries with friends or family, fearing misunderstanding or judgment
In the stress of preparing for travel, bears it alone, avoiding seeking companions' experience
outcomes: Negative rumination reinforced, positive experiences obscured

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Worrying classmates will think one is irresponsible or strange
Believing friends and family will not understand, thus not speaking up

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Constantly self-censoring wording before asking for help, worrying about seeming offensive or abrupt
Repeatedly blaming oneself 'I just cannot save enough' without trying new methods

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not seeking help and information outwardly, instead soothing Anxiety through instant consumption
Pressing the impulse to obtain support back onto myself, forming self-consumption

positive_force: An attitude willing to try 'small-step experiments' (open to trying counseling suggestions)
Able to clearly identify and describe own negative thoughts and emotions
Has a certain degree of social support (friends to talk with)
Travel itself has much positive material available for reframing
negative_force: Cognitive distortion patterns such as negating the positive, mental filtering, and black-and-white thinking are prominent
Highly sensitive to others' evaluations, tending to mind-read and anticipate negative outcomes, avoiding seeking help
Using consumption for emotional regulation to escape Anxiety, undermining saving goals
Continued rumination leads to Low mood and decreased motivation, reinforcing problem beliefs

target_behavior.behavior: Negative rumination and mental filtering about travel experiences
antecedent: Recalling the Frankfurt trip and thinking of travel inconveniences (crowded flights, expensive food, no WiFi)
Seeing travel-related cues or hearing travel discussed
target_behavior.core_reason: Evaluating the overall experience with black-and-white thinking and negating the positive, trying to gain control and certainty through rumination
target_behavior.function: Briefly validating worries and gaining cognitive 'certainty', avoiding facing complex ambivalent feelings
target_behavior.consequence: Positive experiences obscured, Low mood and dissatisfaction maintained and worsened

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidant consumption and budget avoidance under Anxiety
antecedent: Facing the savings goal and budget plan for the class trip to Japan
Consumption triggers appearing (such as going out with friends, wanting instant gratification)
target_behavior.core_reason: Believing 'no matter what I cannot save enough', easing Anxiety and feelings of deprivation through consumption
target_behavior.function: Avoiding discomfort and gaining short-term emotional soothing
target_behavior.consequence: Savings blocked; stress and self-blame worsen, forming a vicious cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding asking others for help or information
antecedent: When thinking about asking classmates about experience or budget methods
Anticipating others will evaluate oneself negatively
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing judgment and shame, mind-reading and catastrophizing leading to Social avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential shame and negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient resources and information, Sense of isolation and Anxiety maintained
